name: *arr Dashboard
description: At-a-glance dashboard for Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, SABnzbd, Youtarr, and LidaTube — downloads, health, disk space, and upcoming releases.

options.label: Sonarr URL
options.help: e.g. http://192.168.1.25:8989 — leave blank to hide Sonarr.

options.label: Radarr URL
options.help: e.g. http://192.168.1.25:7878 — leave blank to hide Radarr.

options.label: Lidarr URL
options.help: e.g. http://192.168.1.25:8686 — leave blank to hide Lidarr.

options.label: SABnzbd URL
options.help: e.g. http://192.168.1.25:8080 — leave blank to hide SABnzbd.

options.label: SABnzbd API key
options.help: SABnzbd > Config > General > API Key (full key, not NZB key).

options.label: Youtarr URL
options.help: e.g. http://192.168.1.25:3087 — leave blank to hide Youtarr.

options.label: Youtarr username
options.help: Leave blank if Youtarr runs with AUTH_ENABLED=false.

options.label: LidaTube URL
options.help: e.g. http://192.168.1.25:5000 — up/down check only (LidaTube has no status API).

options.label: Refresh interval
options.help: How often the dashboard polls the servers.
